issues.claim: Two clauses the repair added to the one-page summary misstate their rules. (a) 'a wall long poor and safe shows worn, patched and breached runs that recover when the need and the means return (item 114)': under item 114 (c) a safe wall decays through `worn` to `breached`; `patched` comes only when the need returns with low means (T114-1), so a poor, safe wall never shows patched runs. (b) 'below a town no dwelling takes a court, a tower or a second manor unless the dossier or the user asks (item 115)': under item 115 (b) and §4.7 S10b (3) a THORP or HAMLET takes no manor unless specified and a VILLAGE's one manor needs a lord or a specification (the sentence admits a first manor anywhere), and the ceiling also bars `H` and `U` plans and turrets.
issues.required_change: (a) reads '…, and a wall long safe weathers through worn runs to breaches, a poor one under threat patches its gaps in cheaper material and a rich one rebuilds in stone, recovering when the need and the means return (item 114)'; (b) reads '; below a town a dwelling stays a single range, an L or a T, with no court, tower or turret, a thorp or hamlet has no manor and a village at most one, with a lord — unless the dossier or the user asks (item 115)'.
